hook: Salary 40k se 60k ke [[beech]]? BETWEEN hai na

slides.title: BETWEEN = [[range]]
slides.note: Jaise "18 se 25 saal ke log": 18 aur 25 **dono** allowed 🎂

slides.title: 40k se [[60k]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary
FROM employees
WHERE salary
  BETWEEN 40000 AND 60000;

slides.title: Result: [[boundary]] bhi andar
slides.note: Dev (40k) aur Aarav (60k) **edge** pe hain, phir bhi andar ✅

slides.title: Dates pe bhi [[chalta]]
slides.note: Column DATETIME hai? '01-31' = **raat 12 baje** tak hi. 31 ka din chhoot jaayega ⏰

slides.right: Dono **boundaries include** hoti hain: 40000 aur 60000 andar
slides.why: BETWEEN = **>= AND <=**, isliye edges bhi count 📐

caption:
Salary 40k se 60k ke beech? BETWEEN hai na ↔️

Is post mein:
✅ BETWEEN ka formula
✅ Boundary values andar ya bahar?
✅ Dates pe BETWEEN aur DATETIME trap
✅ Galat order = zero rows
